requirements.notes: Objects, multisig, mixed references, local Manifest graph; restricted KeyInfo; no remote manifests or full transform conformance; approved pure-Go XMLDSig v1 transforms retained.

requirements.notes: Approved XMLDSig XPath 1.0, Filter2 and restricted XSLT 1.0 through the unified Go engine. Exact program allowlist, original node identity, here()/explicit ID rules, shared budgets and no implicit resources. Signed/tampered JDK fixtures cover selected cases; full v1 conformance is not claimed. Detached and template APIs share parameter serialization/parsing; serialized namespace contexts and all recipes are preflighted before resource I/O. Imported stylesheet expanded names are preserved.
requirements.title: XPath / XPath Filter 2.0 / XSLT

requirements.notes: AES-GCM 128/192/256 with direct AES data keys, explicit RSA-OAEP SHA-2/matching MGF1 and bounded label, or AES Key Wrap 128/192/256. Opaque bytes, UTF-8/NFC element and content; exact bounded external CipherReference. No sender authentication or general XMLENC conformance.
requirements.title: XML Encryption

requirements.notes: Octets/node-set, implicit parse and final C14N1.0, budgets, no I/O
requirements.title: Typed reference processing

requirements.notes: Empty URI, bare #ID, limited XPointer. Used in general SignTemplate/VerifySignature with explicit scoped ID rules.

requirements.title: Base64 transform

requirements.notes: Exact same-snapshot containing Signature and its axes, not every Signature
requirements.title: Enveloped-signature transform

requirements.notes: Exact ExpectedURIs, six SI C14N variants opt-in, auth-before-I/O, no trust in KeyInfo
requirements.title: External-detached profile

requirements.notes: Direct/nested statuses, SignatureValue and Manifest status, copied bytes/steps; no partial result.
requirements.title: Digest inputs and processing traces

requirements.notes: Arbitrary Object XML; MimeType/Encoding advisory, no implicit decoding; ds:Id scoped.

requirements.notes: Verification checks selected handle only. Generation requires all other nonempty signatures pinned/pre-post checked.
requirements.title: Explicit multi-signature selection and preservation

requirements.notes: Exact snapshot identity; Base64/reparse loses source coverage; wrapper not implicitly signed.
requirements.title: Conservative source element coverage

requirements.notes: Blank placeholders, dependency graph for supported Manifest refs, immutable copy and serialized self-verify.
requirements.title: Template signing with self-verification

requirements.notes: Opt-in only; bounded reachability, cycles, source coverage, nested negatives; no external Manifest expansion.
requirements.title: Local recursive Manifest DAG

requirements.notes: Exact allowlist, preflight/authentication before I/O, byte cache and self-check replay; preservation passes have independent budgets.
requirements.title: Mixed references with explicit external resolver

requirements.notes: New immutable snapshot; XML root/text/base64/Manifest variants; no signature or trust from builder alone.
requirements.title: Typed Signature/Object/Manifest template construction

requirements.notes: Equal hash/MGF hash and salt digest length; nonmatching salt rejected.
requirements.title: Fixed PSS SHA2

requirements.notes: Signs full message, not prehash; modern policy required; no Ed448/ph/ctx.
requirements.title: Pure Ed25519

requirements.notes: Bounds, authenticated issuer/signature/time/number/extensions; select newest consistent fresh complete CRL, reject same-number conflicts and non-monotonic numbers independent of evidence order. No delta/scoped/indirect CRLs.
requirements.title: Offline direct complete CRL subset

requirements.notes: Exact encoded parameters authenticated before decompress; no SSO acceptance.
requirements.title: Signed HTTP-Redirect binding

requirements.notes: Single-process only, batch all-or-nothing, no active-ID eviction; not invoked automatically by binding.
requirements.title: Atomic bounded replay-store primitive

requirements.notes: Two-reference shape, signed cert DER/time/data format, explicit cert; not full baseline validation.
requirements.title: Restricted basic enveloped properties

requirements.notes: IV12/tag16; caller-selected GCM algorithm, explicit matching SHA-256/384/512 digest and MGF1, PSource label bounded to 1024 bytes. Parameter order independent, duplicates/mixed hashes/omitted SHA-1 defaults rejected before provider use. Bidirectional xmlsec1/OpenSSL checks and independent crypto/rsa decryption.
requirements.title: Restricted AES-GCM with explicit SHA-2 RSA-OAEP parameters

requirements.notes: Explicit KEK/API/algorithm, exact session-key length before AES rounds, six official vectors, all nine GCM/KW combinations independently tested. No general key discovery/chains or sender authentication.
requirements.title: RFC 3394 AES Key Wrap 128/192/256 for AES-GCM session keys

requirements.limitations: Definite-length SignedData with strict signedAttrs; not arbitrary BER/full CMS/countersignatures.
Offline issuer/delegated response verification; bounded single-identifier requests; not all extensions.
Imprint/nonce/policy/ESS/EKU/current PKIX; no trusted clock/service or historical POE implementation.
Root-enveloped form; rejects unsupported extra unsigned properties instead of guessing.
NOT full EN319102-1 historical validation, universal XAdES or automatic renewal across new TSA/evidence regimes.
Explicit pin/out-of-band trust; strict supported structures; no dynamic metadata network service.
No unsolicited/SLO/Artifact/ECP/queries/encrypted assertion application profile or real external IdP interop.

requirements.notes: Independent MGF1 SHA-2, exact salt incl zero; native signing only same-hash positive salt. Other configurations need explicit provider; no SHA1/SHA224/SHA3/other MGF/trailer.
requirements.title: Generic RSA-PSS SHA-2 profile

requirements.notes: SHA256/384/512; opt-in, full tags by default, minimum half-hash, whole bytes, shared secret never inferred from KeyInfo, all references verified.
requirements.title: HMAC separate trust mode and truncation policy

requirements.notes: POST and Redirect: first explicit default, then first unspecified, then first endpoint; trusted binding/URL/index restrictions apply.
requirements.title: ACS selection in metadata order

requirements.notes: Oversized request/response rejected before an input-size allocation.
requirements.title: Bound input before cloning or parsing

requirements.notes: All tokens verified at current TSA trust; earliest GenTime+Accuracy proof, signer PKIX and fresh revocation at proof; SigningTime ignored. Refuses archive/expired-TSA/known later revocation recovery. No full historical EN319102-1 or algorithm migration.
requirements.title: Restricted trusted signature proof and historical signer PKIX

requirements.notes: Exact digest/signature identifiers modulo supported equivalent parameter encodings; distinct RSA OIDs rejected even when the cryptographic operation is compatible.
requirements.title: CMS AlgorithmIdentifier protection

requirements.notes: Known signed-only attributes rejected in unsignedAttrs; countersignature rejected in signedAttrs. One SigningTime, UTC seconds, UTCTime 1950-2049; asserted time never establishes trust. Unknown/countersignature semantics are not validated.
requirements.title: Signed attribute placement and SigningTime syntax

requirements.notes: ProducedAt, ThisUpdate, NextUpdate and RevocationTime require UTC with seconds, no fraction or offset (RFC5280 4.1.2.5.2). Authenticated negative controls cover all four fields; timestamp GenTime remains a distinct profile.
requirements.title: PKIX OCSP GeneralizedTime profile

requirements.notes: XML production 39, UTF-8 and NFC. Reject declaration, prolog/epilog, UTF-16 and non-NFC serialization for RSA and AES Key Wrap; opaque byte API unchanged, no automatic normalization. Exact NFC validation accepts normalized long non-starter runs and preserves original CGJ.
requirements.title: Element plaintext serialization profile

requirements.notes: Optional bidirectional comparisons for overlapping profiles; the harness requires xmlsec1 1.3.10+ and logs installed engine versions. CI installs Debian binary packages. Known canonicalization, XPath focus and empty-content differences are separate diagnostics; the C API probe checks authenticated empty buffers and rejected tags. Harness coverage does not establish full conformance or trust certification.
requirements.title: Generated bidirectional XMLDSig/XMLENC interop with xmlsec1/OpenSSL

requirements.notes: One caller-selected element and exact new handle; parent namespace context, local xmlns reset, siblings and document-level nodes preserved; embedded signatures tested with six C14N variants. Independent plaintext/full-output limits and no result on failure. Whole-structure super-encryption only; automatic search and recursive decryption excluded. Content has a separate entry. Parent context and sender trust require application validation.
requirements.title: Explicit immutable Type #Element replacement in parent context

requirements.notes: All 12 allowed suites, empty/text/mixed/multiple-child content, independent forest and complete-output limits. Encryption returns the exact EncryptedData handle; decryption returns its restored parent's handle. No additional cipher namespace bindings enter plaintext. Authenticated malformed-input/fuzz tests and six embedded-signature C14N modes. Standalone Content without element parent, partial encryption of cipher structures, recursive decryption and sender trust excluded. Tested xmlsec1 empty-content failures are separate diagnostics.
requirements.title: Explicit immutable Type #Content replacement with parent context

requirements.notes: Nil preserves all recognized representations; explicit empty denies all. QName policy frozen before callbacks. KeyValue leaf types, same-document and fetched targets checked; typed target checks and direct siblings preflight before I/O. Untyped explicitly allowed retrieval can fetch before the target form is known. No change to URI/trust policy; no global registry.
requirements.title: Operation-local KeyInfo representation allowlist

requirements.notes: Explicit plain/encrypted PKCS#8/PKCS#12 private loading with a bounded trusted password file, no password in argv, KDF work limits, no signature or output-file changes on load failure. Public PEM/DER keys and certificates remain explicit pins without PKIX trust. HSM provider management excluded.
requirements.title: Bounded PEM/DER private/public key and pinned-certificate loading

requirements.notes: One unencrypted PKCS#8/RSA PKCS#1/EC SEC1 private key, SPKI/RSA PKCS#1 public key or X.509 certificate/CRL. Authoritative PEM labels, complete bounded DER, owned input, pre-validation RSA component limits. No trust or I/O; password containers use separate explicit APIs.
requirements.title: Bounded PEM/DER key, certificate and CRL parsing

requirements.notes: AES128/192/256 keys of exact caller-selected size; random 96-bit nonce, 128-bit tag, no EncryptedKey, optional exact KeyName hint. Bytes/root/selected Element/Content share authentication/limits/snapshot contracts. Independent crypto/cipher and bidirectional xmlsec1 checks.
requirements.title: Explicit direct AES-GCM data keys

requirements.notes: Exact absolute URI through application-owned resolver, no implicit I/O, raw or one ds:base64 transform in xenc:Transforms, readers closed, pre-transform and decoded byte limits. Inline EncryptedKey only; no same-document URI/arbitrary programs. ExternalizeCiphertext returns immutable snapshot and owned raw data. Authentication and typed XML restoration remain mandatory.
requirements.title: Bounded explicit external ciphertext resources

requirements.notes: PBES2/PBKDF2 with explicit SHA-256/384/512 PRFs and AES-128/192/256-CBC. Fresh salts/IVs; complete version-zero PrivateKeyInfo with bounded attributes, component validation before KDF export, RSA snapshot without caller CRT mutation. Owned input/password data and bounded cancellable work; no partial result. Standalone PKCS#8 does not authenticate ciphertext; legacy ciphers/scrypt/BER excluded.
requirements.title: Bounded encrypted PKCS#8 import/export

requirements.notes: DER PFX version 3 with mandatory MAC verified before bag decryption, exactly one private key and matching certificate; canonical public-key binding and conflicting identifier/duplicate/ambiguous identity rejection. SHA-2 classic MAC import/export, no alternate empty-password fallback. Eight ContentInfos, 32 flat bags, 16 certificates, known attributes; no nested bags/BER/RC2/3DES/SHA-1 or implicit certificate trust.
requirements.title: Authenticated bounded PKCS#12 identities

requirements.notes: Default PKCS#12 export; UTF-8 password bytes, explicit PBKDF2 PRF and required keyLength equal to SHA-2 HMAC output size. Outer macSalt/iterations ignored as required, including integers larger than machine int. PRF and MAC hash independently selected on import; aggregate work counts all PBKDF2 blocks. Empty/missing/wrong MAC rejected. Fixed size/SHA-2 profile, not general PBMAC1 support.
requirements.title: RFC 9879 PBMAC1 PKCS#12 password integrity

requirements.notes: One Go engine with shared immutable XDM values, language version checks, typed parameters, invocation budgets, explicit resource resolvers and owned primary/secondary outputs. Standalone XPath/XSLT 1.0 and approved XMLDSig v1 programs use the same compiler and evaluator. Full QT3/XSLT suites have not been run; schema awareness, streaming and a public package resolver are unsupported. Numeric intermediates use cumulative binary-magnitude accounting, including rational numerator/denominator, conservative arithmetic/rounding preflight and AST/VM/XSLT paths. Required subsequence length cardinality follows F&O 2.0/3.0/3.1.
requirements.title: XPath 1.0/2.0/3.0/3.1 and XSLT 1.0 / Basic XSLT 2.0/3.0

requirements.notes: Grouped, bounded CLI for XMLDSig including parameterized PSS/HMAC/approved transforms, canonicalization, XML Encryption, key import/export, KeyInfo pins, offline PKIX/OCSP/CMS/RFC3161/XAdES and SAML primitives. Runtime-pollable inherited Unix streams support cancellation; strict URI/path verification manifests never silently accept signing recipes. No implicit network resource lookup, KeyInfo trust, stateful WebSSO session/replay guarantee, HSM management or full standards-conformance claim. See docs/cli.md for the scope and configuration contracts.
requirements.title: Command-line application and bounded local I/O contracts

requirements.notes: Strict UTC dateTime lexical form, four-digit positive years, up to nine fractional digits, midnight normalization. SAML cache durations use exact nanoseconds, positive day/time subset up to 365 days. Higher precision is explicitly unsupported; signer time is not trusted time.
requirements.title: XML Schema time syntax and exact SAML duration arithmetic

requirements.notes: New supplied request nonces require 32--128 bytes; the CLI generates 32 random bytes by default. Optional absence is retained. Inbound requests and response binding accept legacy 1--128 byte nonces; supplied randomness is the caller responsibility.
requirements.title: RFC 9654 requester and responder nonce boundaries

requirements.notes: nextUpdate is exclusive, including configured clock skew. Undefined/negative response statuses are malformed evidence, not valid responder error statuses. Authenticated freshness boundary tests.
requirements.title: OCSP response status syntax and exclusive freshness boundary

requirements.notes: F&O rule ordering, FONS0005 for absent static base, FORG0002 for unsuitable bases, RFC 3986 resolution over original IRI components. Unicode and existing escapes retain identity; empty query/fragment delimiters are preserved. No retrieval; C14N 1.1 retains its separate modified algorithm.
requirements.title: XPath resolve-uri and RFC 3986 component preservation

requirements.notes: PKCS#8 version zero and bounded valid attribute sets; complete canonical PKCS#1 versions/components/CRT values including multi-prime inputs. Fixed-size EC scalar, consistent named curve and matching optional uncompressed public key; PKCS#8 may inherit outer curve. Applies to plain and password container import; no trust decision.
requirements.title: Explicit private-key grammar beyond crypto/x509 legacy tolerance

scope: Experimental XML security toolkit with bounded signatures, encryption, key containers, XPath/XSLT, offline trust/evidence verification, closed XAdES profiles and solicited SAML WebSSO; not a full standards conformance claim.
